rationale: Maintainer/correctness critics EXECUTED: plain git status rewrites .git/index and takes index.lock, making a concurrent git add fail rc=128; --no-optional-locks keeps output accurate without writing but never amortizes (~80-230 ms), hence the cache and placement. `git push` changes ahead/behind with HEAD and FETCH_HEAD unchanged, so those alone are an insufficient key. git diff-index --quiet is not a substitute (5,137 false positives after an mtime touch — pinned as a regression test).
summary: Any git working-tree probe runs as `git --no-optional-locks status`, TTL-cached by projectRoot with the upstream sha in the key, invoked only from twining_status and the assemble path — never from the per-dispatch wrapper
